#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class J {
private:
    bool ONLINE_JUDGE = getenv("ONLINE_JUDGE") != nullptr;
    std::istream* inputStream;
    std::ostream* outputStream;
    std::string buffer;
    std::istringstream tokens;

    void initialize() {
        if (ONLINE_JUDGE) {
            inputStream = &std::cin;
            outputStream = &std::cout;
        } else {
            inputStream = new std::ifstream("input.txt");
            outputStream = new std::ofstream("output.txt");
        }
    }

    std::string getToken() {
        while (!(tokens >> buffer)) {
            std::getline(*inputStream, buffer);
            tokens.clear();
            tokens.str(buffer);
        }
        return buffer;
    }

    int getInt() {
        return std::stoi(getToken());
    }

    long long getLong() {
        return std::stoll(getToken());
    }

    double getDouble() {
        return std::stod(getToken());
    }

    std::vector<int> getIntArray(int size) {
        std::vector<int> arr(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            arr[i] = getInt();
        }
        return arr;
    }

    long long startTime, endTime;
    int INF = 10000000;
    int[][][][] dpTable;
    char[] sequenceChars;

    int computeCost(const std::vector<char>& arr, char target, int v, int k, int x) {
        int cost = 0;
        for (char c : arr) {
            if (c == 'V') {
                v--;
                if (v == 0 && target == 'V') return cost;
                if (v < 0) cost++;
            }
            if (c == 'K') {
                k--;
                if (k == 0 && target == 'K') return cost;
                if (k < 0) cost++;
            }
            if (c == 'X') {
                x--;
                if (x == 0 && target == 'X') return cost;
                if (x < 0) cost++;
            }
        }
        throw std::runtime_error("Invalid state");
    }

    void reportTime() {
        endTime = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
            std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch()
        ).count();
        std::cerr << "Execution time: " << (endTime - startTime) << std::endl;
    }

public:
    void run() {
        initialize();
        startTime = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
            std::chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch()
        ).count();
        execute();
        if (!ONLINE_JUDGE) {
            delete inputStream;
            delete outputStream;
        }
        reportTime();
    }

    void execute() {
        int n = getInt();
        std::string seqStr = getToken();
        sequenceChars = seqStr.c_str();

        int vCount = 0, kCount = 0, xCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < seqStr.size(); i++) {
            if (sequenceChars[i] == 'V') vCount++;
            else if (sequenceChars[i] == 'K') kCount++;
            else {
                sequenceChars[i] = 'X';
                xCount++;
            }
        }

        dpTable = std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>>(
            vCount + 1,
            std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>(
                kCount + 1,
                std::vector<std::vector<int>>(
                    xCount + 1,
                    std::vector<int>(3, INF)
                )
            )
        );

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            dpTable[0][0][0][i] = 0;
        }

        for (int v = 0; v <= vCount; v++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= kCount; k++) {
                for (int x = 0; x <= xCount; x++) {
                    for (int prevState = 0; prevState < 3; prevState++) {
                        int currentCost = dpTable[v][k][x][prevState];
                        if (currentCost == INF) continue;
                        if (v + 1 <= vCount) {
                            int cst = computeCost(std::vector<char>(sequenceChars, sequenceChars + seqStr.size()), 'V', v + 1, k, x);
                            dpTable[v + 1][k][x][0] = std::min(dpTable[v + 1][k][x][0], currentCost + cst);
                        }
                        if (k + 1 <= kCount) {
                            int cst = computeCost(std::vector<char>(sequenceChars, sequenceChars + seqStr.size()), 'K', v, k + 1, x);
                            if (prevState != 0) {
                                dpTable[v][k + 1][x][1] = std::min(dpTable[v][k + 1][x][1], currentCost + cst);
                            }
                        }
                        if (x + 1 <= xCount) {
                            int cst = computeCost(std::vector<char>(sequenceChars, sequenceChars + seqStr.size()), 'X', v, k, x + 1);
                            dpTable[v][k][x + 1][2] = std::min(dpTable[v][k][x + 1][2], currentCost + cst);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int answer = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            answer = std::min(answer, dpTable[vCount][kCount][xCount][i]);
        }

        *outputStream << answer << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    J solver;
    solver.run();
    return 0;
}
